title: A Sky Worth Remembering
description: Orin wants to compare the night sky here with the one he remembers from another world.
completion_text: Orin discovers that sharing an unanswered question with a friend can be enough.

stages.title: A Sky Worth Remembering
stages.lead: Craft a spyglass and compare sky observations with Orin.
notes: A personal request from Orin. The quest is only offered through their friendship dialogue.

objectives.description: Discuss the stars and your shared uncertainty with Orin.
